Package com.egradx.auth.profile

Interface EgradxContactVerificationSender

All Known Implementing Classes:
EgradxNotificationContactVerificationSender
public interface EgradxContactVerificationSender
Delivers a verification code to an address someone has added to their profile.

egradx-auth cannot send anything itself — delivery is egradx-notification's job — so it asks. egradx-notification-auth implements this by sending the code through the channel being verified. Without an implementation, verifying by code is unavailable and says so; an administrator can still mark an address verified.

Called inside the transaction that stores the code: an implementation that queues through an outbox therefore sends the code if and only if it was stored.
